description.value: West Coast Suites is UBC's premium on-campus hotel offering studio and one-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, situated on the forested UBC Vancouver peninsula about 20-25 minutes from downtown. Operated year-round by UBC Student Housing, the property is heated by biomass generation and hydro electricity, reflecting UBC's sustainability focus. Guests have access to laundry facilities on-site and are steps from the campus's beaches, gardens, and biodiversity museum.
